At 7:15 on August 8th, I approached them politely to buy a hamburger ($23,300). It was crazy! Not only was the service poor and unenthusiastic, but I also felt bad about the way they offered things (they didn't offer them; I asked about the options and she told me they weren't available, even though by law they have to). Because of the bad service, I told them to go to Caon, their competition, and they replied that I should go there because they had prepared hamburgers.

reviews.comment:
El ACA YPF de  Villa María está ubicado en la intersección de dos Bulevares y la Salida hacia la Antigua Ruta 9. Es de fácil acceso y posee buen combustible.
Para utilizar "aire para las cubiertas" hay que comprar un cospel a los playeros.
Ofrece surtidores con "servicio de personal" o para "autoservicio" (mas económico).
Es una Sucursal de ACA (Automóvil Club Argentino) donde se puede adquirir el Registro para Conducir Automotores Internacional.
Hay Tienda con Bar y Baños muy limpios.
Toda la Estación está restaurada.

(Translated by Google)
The ACA YPF station in Villa María is located at the intersection of two boulevards and the exit to the old Route 9. It is easily accessible and has good fuel.
To get air for your tires, you have to buy a token from the attendants. It offers pumps with staff service or self-service (which is cheaper). It is an ACA (Automóvil Club Argentino) branch where you can obtain an International Driver's License. There is a convenience store with a bar and very clean restrooms. The entire station has been renovated.
